items.item_text: Bachelor’s degree in Radiation Therapy or related field required

The Associate Chief Radiation Therapist supports the Chief Radiation Therapist in managing the daily operations of the Radiation Oncology Department. Key responsibilities include reviewing and coordinating patient treatment schedules, overseeing room utilization, and conducting staff orientation to treatment equipment. This role has direct responsibility for staff scheduling, linear accelerator utilization, review of treatment plans, physician orders, and record-and-verify documentation prior to treatment initiation. The Associate Chief also serves as a resource for staff and collaborates on staff educational development initiatives.

In addition, this role ensures high-quality patient care, maintains compliance with safety and regulatory standards, and contributes to strategic planning and implementation of clinical protocols. The Associate Chief performs the full scope of duties of the Chief Radiation Therapist—excluding performance evaluations and timecard management. The role may also assist with research projects, innovative treatment techniques, or complex therapeutic procedures. Additional responsibilities include supporting training programs for student technologists, coordinating formal learning opportunities for staff and visiting professionals, collaborating on quality assurance initiatives, and facilitating staff safety and competency coordination.
Multiple years in a lead role in radiation therapy.
Bilingual skills in English and/or Spanish, Russian
